meta.name: ai-search-optimization
meta.description: Optimizes for AI assistants and AI-generated answers — being retrievable, being cited, and being represented accurately when a model answers on your behalf. Use this when traffic is shifting from links to AI answers, when a brand is misrepresented or absent in AI responses, when planning content for retrieval rather than ranking, or when deciding how AI search changes an existing SEO program.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让品牌在 AI 答案中被准确呈现与引用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果品牌在 AI 回答中的表现让你担忧,想主动优化被检索与引用的效果。
copy.tagline_en: Get your brand accurately cited in AI-generated answers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you worry about how AI answers present your brand and want better visibility.

howto.what: Claude 会按 AI 引用标准优化内容:首句直接作答,段落自含、信息可溯源;并建议定期向多个 AI 助手核查公司描述,修正错误来源。
howto.when: 当流量从链接转向 AI 回答、品牌在 AI 回复中缺失或被歪曲、或需规划检索式内容或评估 AI 搜索对 SEO 的影响时触发。

say.text: 把这段介绍改写成 AI 容易引用的样子,首句直接回答。
say.note: Claude 会按自含段落和直接答案的原则重写。

say.text: 检查网站里关于定价和规格的页面,补全 AI 常检索的信息。
say.note: 会维护权威页面,提升被引用概率。

say.text: 用几个 AI 助手问我公司的业务和价格,汇总错误并指出来源。
say.note: Claude 会规划核查并追溯到错误出处。

howto.what_en: Claude optimizes content to be quoted by AI: self-contained passages, answers up front, specific facts, attributed expertise; plus audit AI responses about you and fix sources.
howto.when_en: Triggers when traffic shifts from links to AI answers, when a brand is missing or misrepresented in AI responses, or when planning content for retrieval or assessing AI search's impact on SEO.

say_en.text: Rewrite this intro so AI can quote it easily, with the answer first.
say_en.note: Claude rewrites for self-contained passages and direct answers.

say_en.text: Check our pricing and spec pages and fill in what AI often retrieves.
say_en.note: Maintains canonical pages to boost citation likelihood.

say_en.text: Ask several AI assistants about our business and price, then summarize errors and sources.
say_en.note: Claude plans the audit and traces errors to their origins.
